non_claims: The claim ions mark the carnitine moiety; the acyl ester is implied by the precursor composition hypothesis only.
Acyl chain length, branching and double-bond position are unresolved; chain isomers give the same CID spectra (src:5, src:6).
Hydroxy, dicarboxylic and conjugated acyl chains are outside this composition series and are not claimed by it.

notes: measure:false, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19) pending the author: acylcarnitines are lipid-adjacent and already covered by the MS-DIAL CAR lipid rules (design Q3), so this rule is kept but not measured.

competitors.note: Betaines (src:9) and choline, N-trimethyllysine and their derivatives (src:1) share C3H10N+, and the C3H9N loss is not class-specific (src:7); succinylmonocholine is isomeric with acetylcarnitine.

priors.note: Fatty acyl chains C2-C26 are enumerated, inside the C0-C26 acyl-chain range of the targeted method built with 49 acylcarnitine standards.
At most min(6, floor((n-1)/2)) C=C bonds for a Cn fatty acyl chain.
